description: React component for the Canvas Header UI, managing chatflow actions, dialogs, and navigation.

methods.name: onSettingsItemClick
methods.description: Handles user actions from the settings menu, such as delete, view messages, export, duplicate, etc.

methods.name: onUploadFile
methods.description: Handles file upload to load a new flow.

methods.name: submitFlowName
methods.description: Saves the new flow name via API.

methods.name: onAPIDialogClick
methods.description: Prepares and opens the API embed dialog, analyzing flow data for required parameters.

methods.name: onSaveChatflowClick
methods.description: Triggers save flow action or opens save dialog.

methods.name: onConfirmSaveName
methods.description: Confirms and executes saving a new flow with the specified name.
